name: Diataxis
description: A plugin for improving project documentation using the Diataxis framework. It surveys an existing codebase, classifies current documentation as tutorials, how-to guides, reference, or explanation, identifies gaps and mixed-purpose docs, proposes a structured documentation plan, and writes approved documents one at a time with user review at every stage.
longDescription:
Ships **7 skills**.

- **Skills** (7): `document` (Use to orchestrate a complete Diátaxis documentation workflow from survey and planning through iterative document implementation and refinement), `explanation` (Write Diátaxis-compliant explanation documentation that deepens understanding through context, reasoning, and conceptual discussion), `how-to-guide` (Write a Diátaxis-compliant how-to guide focused on helping competent users accomplish a specific real-world task or solve a…), `reference` (Write Diátaxis-compliant reference documentation that describes the machinery clearly, accurately, and neutrally), `survey` (Use when surveying a codebase and planning a complete documentation system using the Diátaxis framework), `tutorial` (Write beginner-focused software tutorials that teach one thing well through a reproducible, step-by-step workflow), `write-doc` (Validate one planned Diátaxis document context and route it to the correct specialised writer for tutorial, how-to guide,…)

Installs with `claude plugin install diataxis@claude-community` from `HRSAndrabi/diataxis`.
